source_document.name: Boreal agreement setup example
source_document.text:
Synthetic public setup example
Vendor: Boreal Relay
Agreement: BR-74
Effective: 2026-01-01 through 2026-12-31
Availability is measured over each UTC calendar month.
For Message Store on the Team plan, monthly availability below 99.9% earns a 12.5% service credit.
Claims must be received within 13 calendar days after month end.
Service credits apply to affected monthly fees on a future invoice.
Claims are based on a complete UTC calendar-month report for the entire service; incident identifiers are not required.

requirements: Compile the source document normally; do not hand-insert the evidence_basis marker or citations.
Approve this exact version only through the ordinary authorized test/rehearsal lifecycle. This setup does not create a human review.
Create the claim through POST /api/correspondence/claims with reviewer authentication.
Enroll each included source for the exact scope and role, with distinct subject, key and grant.
Post each exact envelope through POST /api/correspondence/claims/inbox-boreal-public-month/events with ordinary source authentication.
Server receipt time must be at or after month end and no earlier than observed_at.
monthly_attribution is optional; if supplied it must have independent provenance and agree with coverage.
No incident, component or region is permitted in this whole-service scope.
Expected amounts must come from the real evaluator, not this setup artifact.
